reason: After the wandering scare and the police call I cannot keep relying on luck, so a device that tells me where my child is and lets me talk to them is worth the $249 to me. Twenty dollars a month hurts, but less than another night of not knowing.
objection: Another monthly fee on top of everything else, and whether the GPS and live video actually work when he is in a store or a wooded area, not just in the demo.
would_change_my_mind: A clear answer that the $19.99 plan can be paused or cancelled at any time without a fee, plus a trial I can return the device from if the location is unreliable.
